name: Van Cortlandt flat factor
description: The rule of thumb Kestrel has always used: Van Cortlandt runs 5.5% slower than a flat course in good weather, the same for everyone. It is what a course with no model already does, so picking it changes nothing; it is the baseline to beat. Fork it and fit a line to the Van Cortlandt races you have.
trained_on: Not fitted. A coaches' rule of thumb, checked against Hawks runners' own Van Cortlandt and track times. ln(t_course) = a + b ln(t_flat) + c male, with b = 1 and c = 0.
